title: AI faculty search underway
summary_en: A faculty AI cluster hire is now underway across Danforth Campus schools. So far, more than 500 candidates have submitted applications.

title: US loses measles elimination status. What does that mean for Missouri?
summary_en: Jennifer Layden, MD, PhD, of WashU Bursky Public Health, explains how declining childhood vaccination rates threaten community protection and what families can do to reduce risks.
title_cn: US loses measles elimination status. What does that mean for Missouri?

title: Epstein receives $11 million European Research Council Synergy Grant
summary_en: Lee Epstein, the Ethan A.H. Shepley Distinguished University Professor at WashU, and collaborators have received a grant from the European Research Council to examine how judges’ decisions affect democracy.
title_cn: Epstein receives $11 million European Research Council Synergy Grant

title: Provost West reappointed to role
summary_en: Mark D. West, executive vice chancellor for academic affairs and provost, has been reappointed to his role through June 2030.

title: $43 million extends global study of inherited Alzheimer’s disease
summary_en: Funding from the NIH will help double enrollment in WashU Medicine’s Dominantly Inherited Alzheimer Network Observational Study (DIAN Obs) and explore why some people who inherit Alzheimer’s genes resist the disease.
title_cn: $43 million extends global study of inherited Alzheimer’s disease
